generation.scope: Every pure reduced point curve of degree at most three with disjoint finite residual is either a smooth plane cubic or a triangle. The full triangle stratum is the central PBW family over lambda in G_m minus one, with a split point and the quotient of P(1,1,1,2,2,2) by C3 squared over each lambda. All are AS, have period one, and are flat specializations of smooth cubic windows.

open_mathematics: Classify reduced singular degree-four curves and graph branches with embedded points. Use fixed-ideal and genus-one regularity criteria; continue the general AS and non-point-fiber cases.
